bt: Clouds at sunset, water for sprinkling the grapes. The farm is preparing its own rain.
It is 6 in the morning, and the fridge is already the favourite place in the house.
Wild animals do not wear scarves and do not complain. We can learn something. We will not learn, but we could learn.
The first drink after a day of 35 degrees should have been taxed, truly.
The neighbours nearby are thirty kilometres away, and tonight you do not see them at all.
